feeds.title: Theatre Trip Blog
feeds.description: Theatre Trip is your go-to resource for interviews, audition songs, and tons of fun stuff related to musical theatre & repertoire. My name is Stacy Karyn and I specialize in musical theatre repertoire. I'm the founder of Theatre Trip. I have a TESOL drama certificate, a theatre degree from Hunter College in NYC, and have worked and interned with Broadway and Off-Broadway theatres.

feeds.title: Musical Theatre Musings
feeds.description: Welcome to Musical Theatre Musings. This site is for all things theatre and is run by Sarah McPartlan. I have a huge interest in theatre, especially musical theatre. I'm lucky enough to live on the doorstep of the West End as well as being surrounded by London Fringe theatre. Know everything about Musical Theatre at Musical Theatre Musings.

feeds.title: Beat by Beat Press Blog
feeds.description: Beat by Beat Press is a new online publisher of fresh, contemporary children's musicals founded by a group of writers and arts educators in New York City. It is a resource of drama games for kids, theatre tips, and news about our latest projects!

feeds.title: South Bay Musical Theatre Blog
feeds.description: South Bay Musical Theatre strives to provide high-quality entertainment by bringing together a diverse group of participants in an inclusive, collaborative, and nurturing environment.

feeds.title: Masterworks Broadway Blog
feeds.description: Masterworks Broadway is the home of new and classic cast albums, behind-the-scenes photos, exclusive videos and more! Peter Filichia is the theater critic emeritus for the Star-Ledger in Newark, New Jersey and News 12 New Jersey.

feeds.title: Broadway Artists Alliance Blog
feeds.description: Explore the blog to find out about BAA auditions, upcoming workshops, performance opportunities, and exclusive Master Classes! Broadway Artists Alliance of NYC provides professional-level training in the musical theatre arts for promising young artists by affording them the opportunity to study with current Broadway performers, casting directors, and TONY award winners!

feeds.title: Lyric Arts Blog
feeds.description: Find the latest news on what's going on at Lyric Arts in the blog. Lyric Arts' mission is to enrich lives by creating meaningful performing arts experiences that ignite the imagination, inspire the spirit, and engage the community. We are a growing, non-union professional theater, deeply rooted in the communities we serve, producing inclusive work that entertains, educates, stimulates, and is reflective of the diversity of our audiences and artists.

feeds.title: Basingstoke Amateur Theatrical Society Blog
feeds.description: Catch up on the latest announcements, news, cast interviews and previous show reviews on our blog. Basingstoke Amateur Theatrical Society (BATS) was founded in 1958 and has established a reputation for staging musical theatre productions that are of an exceptional standard using talent from in and around Basingstoke.

feeds.title: Broadway Musical Blog
feeds.description: Dishing out musical theatre news and gossip from the Great White Way. The companion site to The Broadway Musical Home is a directory of Broadway musicals with the story, songs, merchandise, video clips, lyrics, tickets, rights & awards for almost 200 shows.

feeds.title: PHX Stages
feeds.description: PHX Stages, your local source for theatre in the Phoenix metropolitan area: show details, performance calendar, news, information, reviews, photos, discount ticket offers, cast and audition listings. The site covers shows at the top professional, semi-professional and college theatre companies as well as the touring productions at ASU Gammage and the Orpheum Theatre and the Broadway and musical-themed concerts at the Phoenix Symphony Orchestra and the Scottsdale Center for Performing Arts. Tap into their blog and learn more about updates, resources, articles, reviews, and more.

feeds.title: Ruth Leon Theatrewise Blog
feeds.description: Entertainment and reviews - a weekly roundup of what to look out for and what to watch in the arts online. Featuring opera, classical, theatre, cabaret and musical theatre performances. Ruth Leon is a writer, producer, and broadcaster specialising in the performing arts. She writes criticism, book reviews, and feature articles for newspapers and magazines throughout the world and contributes reviews and features to British and American radio, and arts specials to many other radio and television outlets.

feeds.title: The Garden Players Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about Garden Players, our musicals, auditions, training programs and more! Run by performer Betina Hershey, this theater group aims to inspire creativity and confidence in kids through improvisation and new musical theater works.

feeds.title: The Good Night Theatre Collective Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates on our shows, artists, auditions, training programs, tips for starting your career in theatre and more! The Good Night Theatre Collective is a group of artists producing new and entertaining performances in the Sioux Falls, South Dakota area.

feeds.title: New York Theater » Musical
feeds.description: Read articles on musicals in the following segment of the New York Theater. This is Jonathan Mandell's New York Theater blog, where you'll read reviews and news about Broadway, Off-Broadway, and independent theater (aka Off-Off-Broadway), as well as online theater, and occasionally some off-topic commentary.

feeds.title: Broadway & Me
feeds.description: I'm a theater lover. I am happiest when I am sitting in a theater. Or talking about theater. Or reading about theater. Or now blogging about it. If you're reading this, you're probably a theater lover too and I hope you'll keep me company as I blog my way through each Broadway season.

feeds.title: AussieTheatre » Musicals Theatre
feeds.description: The Home of Australian Theatre brings you articles and news on and about Musicals Theatre and artists here. AussieTheatre.com is an interactive theatre and arts platform servicing the Australian performing arts community and theatre-going public. With up-to-date news, features, and blog posts from a team of writers and contributors across the country, Aussie Theatre is Australia's leading theatre website.

feeds.title: ContemporaryMusicalTheatre.com
feeds.description: ContemporaryMusicalTheatre.com is a website that connects voice teachers, students and musical theatre professionals with today's best contemporary writers and songs. Find the latest news and updates on musical theatre here.

feeds.title: Stage Faves Blog
feeds.description: Stage Faves is the UK's only social media directory dedicated to musical theatre. Get to know about musical theatre community building, enhancing the social relationship between fans and their favorite performers, shows and theatres.

feeds.title: San Diego Musical Theatre Blog
feeds.description: Want to be the first to know everything that's happening here at San Diego Musical Theatre? Then check out our local theatre blog for interviews, announcements, and other information about your local way to see Broadway.

feeds.title: JENNIFER PEERS
feeds.description: Jennifer Peers is a voice teacher providing singing lessons and vocal coaching to professional and aspiring performers in musical theatre.

feeds.title: The Broadway Collective Blog
feeds.description: Learn about our courses, students stories, tips for broadway and more. Hi, I'm Robert! I'm a Broadway performer and Founder of The Broadway Collective. We're an elite academy, and we hold our students to the highest standards. If you are serious about working in the musical theatre industry, we can help you get that competitive edge and stand out.

feeds.title: Shuffles
feeds.description: Shuffles is a Broadway TAP and MUSICAL THEATRE SCHOOL for kids and teens. It strives for professionalism balanced with large amounts of fun! Professional training, strong technique, and the joy of performance is the focus at Shuffles.

feeds.title: Filmed Live Musicals Blog
feeds.description: A blog featuring insights into the world of filmed live musicals. The most comprehensive online database of legally filmed stage musicals! Cataloging filmed stage musicals (all legal, no boots!) with a searchable database, weekly newsletter, and bi-weekly podcast.

feeds.title: Marquee Theatrical Productions Blog
feeds.description: Explore the blog for articles on upcoming shows, artists, community news, tips for working in theatre industry and more! Marquee Theatrical Productions is a registered charitable theatre company, whose goal is to promote and create excellence in dramatic and musical theatre, while providing York Region with a local attraction for the community and tourists.

feeds.title: Maghull Musical Theatre Company Blog
feeds.description: Here you can find information on upcoming shows, how to join our society and pictures from some of the shows we have done. Maghull Musical Theatre Company (M.M.T.C.) was founded on the 19th October 1972, (known then as Maghull Amateur Operatic Society)

feeds.title: The SAVI Singing Actor Blog
feeds.description: Get the tools you need to succeed in musicals as an artist with tips for auditioning and working on stage. The SAVI Singing Actor is a compendium of powerful concepts and exercises that have helped generations of musical theater performers.

feeds.title: Musical Theatre Lives In Me Blog
feeds.description: I have been writing for as long as I can really remember, silly stories mostly, but a few years ago I decided that I should combine my love for writing with my passion for musical theatre. So, here we are. Musical Theatre Lives In Me is where I lay all of my thoughts out bare for all to see.

feeds.title: New Line Theatre Blog
feeds.description: New Line was created to involve the people of the St. Louis region in the creation and exploration of provocative, alternative, politically, and socially relevant works of musical theatre. This is a musical theatre blog chronicling the work of New Line Theatre, the only alternative musical theatre company in the country.

feeds.title: Orpheus Musical Theatre Society Blog
feeds.description: The blog features articles with information on our upcoming shows, season updates, auditions, vacancies and more! Orpheus Musical Theatre Society is a not-for-profit registered charity and is North America's second-longest-running organization of its kind. Orpheus has been entertaining Ottawa theatre audiences with musical performances of all kinds since 1906.

feeds.title: Korean Musical Theatre
feeds.description: A blog dedicated to the Korean stage. We try our best and cover most of the popular theatre (around 1000 seats) shows that are put up in Korea!

feeds.title: BoHo Theatre Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest news and announcements from the BoHo Theatre about artists, upcoming shows, tours and more! BoHo Theatre tells stories examining and celebrating human relationships - focusing on the Bohemian pillars of Truth, Beauty, Freedom, and Love - using bold, intimate theatrical stagings.
